answer:
Python 3.9 has been deprecated across the LlamaIndex packages. The changelog shows the same entry for many packages in March 2026, for example:

"chore: deprecate python 3.9 once and for all ([#20956](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/pull/20956))" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md]

This line appears under llama-index-instrumentation 0.5.0 (2026-03-16) and under several other packages, including llama-index-embeddings-litellm, llama-index-embeddings-llamafile, and llama-index-embeddings-autoembeddings.

The excerpts don't say whether 3.9 is fully removed or when it stops being supported. They also don't show a required minimum Python version for each package. For the earlier drop, the changelog records "Dropped python3.8 support" for llama-index-core 0.12.0 (2024-11-17) [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md]. That concerns Python 3.8, not 3.9.
